items.difficulty_reason: Representability lemma (statement 1902-1920, proof 1922-1956): shows the fibre product Hom(V,T) x_Hom(U,T) Hom(W,T) is represented by Hom(V amalg_U W, T) via a Yoneda chain of functorial equalities plus a term-by-term pushout computation; the existence of the Hom objects is cited from the published existence lemma; no verification is omitted beyond the acknowledged term-by-term check. H2: Yoneda bookkeeping with finite limits.
